profile.headline: Android Mobile Developer
profile.summary:
Android mobile developer with extensive experience building scalable, maintainable applications for
enterprise-level platforms, using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and MVVM clean architecture. Designs and
implements CI / CD pipelines integrated with JFrog Artifactory, streamlining build automation and release
tracking for QA teams. Develops RESTful APIs, deep-link routing, push notification workflows, and seamless
third-party SDK integrations to enhance application functionality and user experience. Experienced with
Firebase Crashlytics, Splunk, and LeakCanary for production monitoring and performance optimization. Experienced with Claude Cowork and OpenCode AI-assist coding tools. 

I have a deep IT education with a master's degree in Computer Science from the University of Oklahoma and another master's degree in Information Security I earned in China. My bachelor's was in Mathematics.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Led multiple scalable Paycom Android projects using MVVM (clean architecture), Jetpack Compose, Repository Pattern, UseCases, and Hilt for dependency injection to deliver maintainable, testable codebases  and use LeakCanary, Firebase Crashlytics to track memory leak and crashes.

     - Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines for Paycom builds; integrated JFrog Artifactory for artifact management and automated a Confluence-based build-status page for QA and release tracking using Confluence API and linked it to Jira ticket using Jira API.

     - Led the Offline Punch Auto‑Sync feature: parsed JSON payloads, implemented reliable background syncing with WorkManager (customized coroutine Worker with network restriction, retries, and worker status monitoring), and built push-notification workflows to report sync results and drive navigation from notifications.

    - Led implementation of mileage-tracker auto-merge feature for same-day business trips using Realm DB, Repository Pattern, and UseCases to handle complex trip merges, trip edits and corresponding receipt modification and engineered high-performance transactional merge logic with Realm write transactions and do schema migrations.

    - Implemented Share Sheet Feature via BottomSheetDialog, handling incoming intents with various file types and enabling seamless in-app navigation and design compose UI to handle all UI states and error status and using retrofit API to upload shared content.

    - Centralized deep-link routing across the app to support multiple entry points and ensure consistent navigation and feature access.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design Mapware Fly android mobile app using Kotlin with MVVM architecture
    Design layout using XML, adding widgets for UI, handling different screen size compatibility 
    Design local Database using Room, access backend API using Retrofit
    Use LiveData to match data accuracy with UI
    Writing test cases for unit tests

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design Zebra ScanGun Android Mobile App in Android platform to ensure
Automation of products inventory tracking system and order shipping system
• Design User Interface layouts in XML and fragments in Kotlin to display App
Widgets for ScanGun Application
• Connect Emulator to test and debug to ensure app quality

positions.title: Back-end Developer
positions.description: Using C#, .NET framework to create RESTful APIs. I Worked on Report Center, writing LINQ query to access MySQL database to generate financial, clinical and patient reports. Create SignalR hub to send message from one client to connected clients. Solve bug tickets and write unit test cases.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Helped students clear confusions and solve problems in Discrete Structures.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Implemented a new method to search PTE solutions based on lattice SVP problem creatively.
